actual: A newly created registered custom_evo task reserves its planned qe_evolution_loops rows with status=pending. _custom_evo_start_state_from_rows counts every pending row as already started, so the canonical custom-evo/run endpoint returns HTTP 409 and tells callers to resume even though the task has never been submitted. Evidence: task qe_20260908_230225_0ae8, current_loop=0, task status=pending, two reserved pending loop rows, canonical start rejected with '2 loop rows already exist'. Preserve durable pre-registration and fail closed for genuinely submitted/queued/running/terminal attempts; do not edit the failed evidence task.
